observed_fact: Rutledge generated early camp run-game buzz at center, including a second-level block during a Montgomery run, and the offense later picked up pressure well for a Stroud completion to Collins.
fantasy_implication: Rutledge is a live center upgrade variable for run efficiency and Stroud protection.

observed_fact: Rutledge anchored against Kayden McDonald in one-on-ones, while Stroud beat pressure with multiple Higgins completions in team work.
fantasy_implication: Positive center and blitz-response evidence but not enough to settle game protection quality.

observed_fact: Klein made catches on seam and team-drill routes; Schultz also separated in one-on-ones and Moreau/Jordan remained involved.
fantasy_implication: Klein has real receiving-role upside behind Schultz but routes must be separated from camp highlights.

observed_fact: Clowney generated repeated edge pressure and McDonald produced back-to-back run-game plays in team work.
fantasy_implication: Houston DST pressure depth looks stronger; third-down package share is the next fantasy test.

observed_fact: Wayne produced multiple standout catches including red-zone and chunk plays; Bond made consecutive catches from Mills and Mertz.
fantasy_implication: WR6/WR7 remains live; Wayne and Bond need preseason/special-teams confirmation.

observed_fact: Stroud threw hot to Marks against an unblocked rusher, and later found Klein for a catch-and-run touchdown.
fantasy_implication: Marks has checkdown utility and Stroud's pressure answer is improving, but role share is unmeasured.

observed_fact: Dell returned to team-drill reps and caught a Davis Mills red-zone touchdown; Whittington produced the practice's best run for a touchdown.
fantasy_implication: Dell participation matters for target hierarchy; Whittington remains a depth RB watch.

observed_fact: Collins opened indoor practice with a sideline catch from Stroud, while Bond made a difficult catch attempt and continued to appear in camp reports.
fantasy_implication: Collins remains the alpha; Bond is pushing toward a roster role.

observed_fact: Klein's preseason debut included an early 31-yard seam catch, 11 snaps, a fourth-down DPI drawn, and run-game work with the starting offensive line.
fantasy_implication: Klein is the top receiving-upside TE behind Schultz, but snap share remains low until first-unit routes are charted.

observed_fact: Wayne caught three passes including Houston's touchdown in the 27-7 preseason loss to the Chargers.
fantasy_implication: Wayne has converted camp production into game evidence but may still be roster-number dependent.

observed_fact: Stroud connected with Hutchinson for multiple explosive plays and hit Higgins across the middle with Montgomery providing blitz pickup.
fantasy_implication: Hutchinson and Higgins remain important route-share watches behind Collins.

observed_fact: Harris described Houston's best offensive practice of camp, with Stroud completions to Bond, Hutchinson, Collins, Higgins, Wayne, and checkdown work to Marks.
fantasy_implication: Passing-game arrow is up, but it still needs starter preseason evidence versus an opponent.

evidence_type: Chronicle projected Montgomery, Marks, Jawhar Jordan and British Brooks as RB keepers, with Whittington on practice squad; it projected Schultz, Klein, Moreau and Stover at TE, with Brevin Jordan cut.
confidence: Jordan/Whittington/Brooks and TE4 decisions should be treated as cutdown-sensitive.

observed_fact: Chronicle projected Ersery, Teller, Rutledge, Ingram and Trent Brown as starters, with Braden Smith behind Brown and Jake Andrews outside the current 53.
fantasy_implication: Center and right tackle remain the most important protection variables for Stroud.

observed_fact: Chronicle identified the defensive line and rookies as risers, noting Clowney's camp impact, Rutledge's first-team center work, McDonald's strength, Bond's catches, and Wright's coverage plays.
fantasy_implication: DST ceiling and rookie role impact are both actionable but need preseason snap confirmation.

observed_fact: Houston signed Brett Rypien and placed Graham Mertz and Joshua Pitsenberger on Reserve/Injured.
fantasy_implication: Mertz/Pitsenberger are removed from opening active-role projections; Rypien affects preseason QB reps only.
Corner/nickel depth should be rechecked before freezing the defensive depth chart.

observed_fact: Houston signed tight end Louis Hansen.
fantasy_implication: Adds camp TE depth but does not change Schultz/Klein/Moreau/Stover without first-unit evidence.
